tool.name: Alevin-Fry quant
tool.description: Quantify expression from a collated RAD file
tool.command:
## cp -r '$input_collated_rad_dir.extra_files_path/$input_collated_rad_dir.metadata.store_root/collated_permit_list' collated_permit_list && ln -s '$input_collated_rad_dir.extra_files_path/$input_collated_rad_dir.metadata.store_root/collated_permit_list' collated_permit_list && ln -s '$input_transcript_to_gene_map' t2g.tsv && mkdir output && #if $sec_advanced_options.quant_subset: ln -s '$sec_advanced_options.quant_subset' quant_subset.tsv && #end if
alevin-fry quant --input-dir collated_permit_list --tg-map t2g.tsv --output-dir output #if $resolution_selection == 'cr_like': --resolution cr-like #else if $resolution_selection == 'cr_like_em': --resolution cr-like-em #else if $resolution_selection == 'parsimony_em': --resolution parsimony-em #else if $resolution_selection == 'parsimony': --resolution parsimony #else if $resolution_selection == 'parsimony_gene': --resolution parsimony-gene #else if $resolution_selection == 'parsimony_gene_em': --resolution parsimony-gene-em #else if $resolution_selection == 'trivial': --resolution trivial #end if
#if $sec_advanced_options.dump_eqclasses: --dump-eqclasses #end if
#if int($sec_advanced_options.num_bootstraps) > 0: --num-bootstraps '$sec_advanced_options.num_bootstraps' #if $sec_advanced_options.summary_stat: --summary-stat #end if #end if
#if $sec_advanced_options.init_uniform: --init-uniform #end if
#if $sec_advanced_options.quant_subset: --quant-subset quant_subset.tsv #end if
#if $sec_advanced_options.multi_sample_output == 'separate': --multi-sample-output separate #else if $sec_advanced_options.multi_sample_output == 'combined': --multi-sample-output combined #else if $sec_advanced_options.multi_sample_output == 'both': --multi-sample-output both #end if && #if $sec_advanced_options.dump_eqclasses: mv output/alevin/gene_eqclass.txt.gz $output_gene_eqclasses && mv output/alevin/geqc_counts.mtx $output_geqc_counts && #end if mv output/alevin/quants_mat.mtx $output_mat_mtx && mv output/alevin/quants_mat_rows.txt $output_mat_rows && mv output/alevin/quants_mat_cols.txt $output_mat_cols && mv output/featureDump.txt $output_feature_dump

param.name: input_collated_rad_dir
param.label: Directory containing the collated RAD file

param.name: dump_eqclasses
param.label: Write equivalence class counts file
param.help: Writes a gene-level, UMI-deduplicated equivalence class counts file. This can be used for subsequent analyses where gene-ambiguous reads have been neither resovled nor discarded.

param.name: num_bootstraps
param.label: Number of bootstraps to use
param.help: Writes bootstrap inferential replicate information to the outputs. This flag is only meaningful with the resolution modes cr-like-em and parsimony-em.

param.name: summary_stat
param.label: Store only summary statistics (of bootstrap)
param.help: Only applicable when bootstrap is used. Writes the summary statistics of the bootstrap replicates (i.e. the mean and variance of the inferential replicates).

param.name: quant_subset
param.label: List of barcodes to quantify
param.help: Barcodes not in this list will be ignored during inference and will not appear in the output quantification matrix.

param.name: multi_sample_output
param.label: Multi-sample output mode
param.help: Output mode for multi-sample data. Either per-sample matrices, one combined matrix, or both. Default value: separate.
